moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio diagonal-wipe, written here): Still content revealed by a 45° edge travelling from the lower-left corner to the upper-right: edge offset 0 → 145 % (of ~232 px on a 200×120 box; clip-path polygon) in 680 ms power4.inOut (easeInOutQuint); a 2 px light line rides the edge while it crosses. Site exit: fade 320 ms power2.in. Params: duration (0.68 s) · angle (45°) · from: góc bắt đầu (dưới trái) · ease (power4.inOut).
